post.content:
Last night, Enterprise Nation took a group of small business founders to Number 11 Downing Street to present our new research on digital and AI adoption among UK small businesses 🤝

During London Tech Week, we had the opportunity to present the findings directly to the Chancellor – putting small business voices in front of government decision-makers where it matters most.

A huge thank you to everyone who joined us on the night – our partners and the small business owners who shared their stories 👏

Read the full report ⤵️
https://lnkd.in/ec5zmtZ2
